constraints: trimmed title must not be empty

relationships: plan_progress_items 1:N tasks via progress_item_id (ON DELETE SET NULL)
reflections N:1 plans via next_plan_id (ON DELETE SET NULL)

triggers.plans_snapshot_before_update: Before relevant plan fields change, save OLD values to plan_history.
triggers.trg_sync_plan_progress_targets: When plan dates change, recalculate progress-item total targets.
triggers.tasks_sync_daily_goal: When a task is created, edited, soft-deleted, moved, or deleted, refresh the affected plan/date daily goal record.
triggers.execution_records_sync_daily_goal: When execution time changes, refresh the affected plan/date daily goal record.
triggers.completion_events_sync_daily_goal: When completion evidence changes, refresh the affected plan/date daily goal record.
triggers.plans_sync_daily_goal: When a plan's dates/status/progress basis changes, refresh existing daily goal records and today's record when applicable.
triggers.plans_sync_daily_goal_insert: When an active plan is created for today, create today's daily goal record.
triggers.plan_progress_items_sync_daily_goal: When a custom progress basis changes, refresh that plan's daily goal records.

complete_task.notes: Changes todo to completed, increments completion_version, and creates exactly one completion_event. Repeated completion on an already-completed task does not create another event.

cancel_task_completion.notes: Returns the task to todo and removes only the completion_event for the current completion_version. execution_records and task_reflections are preserved.

sync_daily_goal_record.notes: Upserts one DB-backed daily goal record from the plan's daily target plus linked tasks, completion evidence, and execution records. Time mode stores minutes; custom mode stores the configured unit.

rules: All duration values are stored in minutes.
Date and overdue comparisons use Asia/Seoul.
deleted tasks use deleted_at and are excluded from normal task lists and review aggregation.
Plan edits snapshot previous values into plan_history.
Task completion uses complete_task(uuid) and completion_events unique(task_id, completion_version) prevents duplicate completion evidence.
Completion cancellation preserves execution_records and task_reflections.
A task execution record never overwrites the task's planned estimated_minutes.
progress_item_id is optional for backward compatibility.
progress_amount contributes to custom-unit activity progress only when the task is completed.
plan_progress_items.target_value equals daily_target_value multiplied by inclusive plan days.
Goal creation chooses one primary progress basis: time or a user-defined unit.
Time-mode activity progress uses execution_records.actual_minutes for completed tasks.
Custom-mode activity progress uses completed task progress_amount for the primary progress item.
Overall goal progress is derived from period progress and activity progress.

A plan can be completed manually, or the app can auto-complete it when overall progress reaches 100% and there is no incomplete task for that plan due today. Future tasks do not block this auto-completion.
important_dates stores user-defined calendar dates independently from plans and tasks.
The monthly calendar and weekly date strip share the same selected date.
Full JSON export includes plans, plan_history, plan_progress_items, tasks, execution_records, completion_events, task_reflections, reflections, and important_dates.
The browser uses only a publishable Supabase key; service_role and secret keys must not be included in client code.
daily_goal_records stores one summary row per big goal and date.
A daily goal record keeps the day's progress basis, target, actual amount, planned task count, and completed task count.
Existing daily goal records are derived from real plans/tasks/completion events/execution records; missing past activity is not fabricated.
The current day's record can be synchronized for active plans so the daily target exists in the DB even before actual execution time is recorded.
Full JSON export includes daily_goal_records.
